title: The Hunger Games
author: Suzanne Collins
summary: In a future nation where each district must send two teenagers to fight to the death on television, sixteen-year-old Katniss volunteers to take her little sister's place.
readIf: you want a fast, tense survival story with a resourceful heroine and sharp social commentary.
skipIf: children being forced to kill each other is something you want to avoid.

pairings.reason: An adult, far bloodier take on a young person fighting a rigged system.
A quiet, thoughtful dystopia with a young hero, for a slower and more reflective read.
Another young adult dystopia built around a morally fraught system, with more dark humour.
